name: Sorashita
source:
Twelve years ago boy got in an unforgettable incident. At that time certain girl helped him out.

At present time gears that start to move again, and hidden facts from the past start to get revealed one after another. You never know the importance of things until they are gone...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
十二年前，少年遭遇了一件终生难忘的事。那时，有一位少女帮助了他。

如今，命运的齿轮再次转动，过往被掩藏的真相也逐一浮现。有些事物，只有失去后，才会明白它有多么重要……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
